verdict.rationale: Prefix/prompt caching is a fair performance axis for a local LLM runtime like LM Studio. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions prefix caching, KV-cache reuse, or speeding up repeated prompts. The only nearby items are GPU offload and context-length load flags and on-demand model loading, which are different features and earn no credit.
